kicker: The Sports Page's first talk · George Mason University
title: The Water Cooler Is the Classroom
description: The Sports Page's first talk: why statistics belongs at the water cooler, and how sports gets it there. Every slide, with what was said.
lede: This is the first talk anyone has given about The Sports Page, at George Mason University on November 4, 2026. The argument takes three points: the way we teach statistics keeps getting the same results; so take it to the people, story first and statistics second; and make the uncertainty something they can act on. Every slide is here, with what I said beneath it. The backup slides at the end show the paper up close: how it is built, the logic underneath it, and the people who keep it honest.
cta: If you were in the room, or you just found this, I want to hear from you. Send the argument at your water cooler that a number could settle to ideas@thesportspage.net. Tell me what you know that I don't; this paper needs people who know things. And subscribe: one question a day, free, in your inbox.
